classification: BMW Feedback Type and Vfc level2 topic where present; whole-word keyword rules otherwise

not_proposed.note: Counted but not proposed. Missing evidence is silence, not low priority.

validation.independent_recount: 168 of 168 label-based requirements match a separate recount of the workbooks
validation.nextjs_production_build: not re-run after the classification change

known_limitations: All observed requirements lack at least one required dated velocity, validated sales-causality, or competitor two-year ROI input.
The BMW topic to C01-C10 table is a project judgement and has not been reviewed by BMW.
No BMW topic maps to C03 Price with enough respondents, so C03 has no requirement.
Requirement statements are templates around BMW topic names, not reviewed requirement wording.
G60 and G70 feedback is over 90% US and there is no China feedback, so no regional conflict meets the sample gate.
Raw records and signals are reproducible but excluded from the published Git snapshot because of their generated size.
